{"metadata":{"description":"Read assistant replies aloud in DeepSeek Harness: text-to-speech providers with streaming playback.","id":"gh:1368599887","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-plugin-speech","slug":"NakamuraIA/dsh-plugin-speech","topics":["accessibility","deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh-plugin","edge-tts","read-aloud","text-to-speech","tts"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Read assistant replies aloud in DeepSeek Harness: text-to-speech providers with streaming playback."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-speech"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Read assistant replies aloud in DeepSeek Harness, one continuous voice per reply."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Each finished assistant message gets a play control in its action row. Press it and the reply is spo"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ken through a text-to-speech service; press it again and it stops. A settings row in General owns th"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"e service, the voice, and the tuning."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The whole reply goes out in **one request** and the host streams the audio back while the service is"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" still synthesizing it. The browser holds back only the first **1.5 seconds** of audio — enough to c"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"over the first chunk's jitter — and starts the voice: measured at about **one second** from the clic"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"k, with a two-minute reading arriving in under two seconds from then on."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Providers"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Service | Key needed | Voices |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| **Microsoft Edge** (default) | no | the service publishes its full catalog, every language it serv"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"Microsoft Edge** (default) | no | the service publishes its full catalog, every language it serves |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Adding a provider means adding one folder under `src/providers/` and one line in `src/providers/regi"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"stry.ts` — the settings screen builds its fields from what the provider declares."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### The Edge token"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Every handshake carries a short-lived `Sec-MS-GEC` token: the current time in Windows file-time tick"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"s, rounded down to five minutes, digested together with the well-known client token. In October 2026"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" the endpoint moved to a **second generation** of that token — a patched SHA-256 paired with a 64-bi"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"t checksum — and began answering the first generation with a bare `403` (`Edge TTS WebSocket error: "},{"id":"p13s5","text":"Unexpected server response: 403`), which is what a reply that never speaks looks like from the brows"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"er. `src/providers/edge/gec.ts` reproduces the accepted generation; `server.ts` hands it to `msedge-"},{"id":"p13s7","text":"tts` by replacing the library's private URL builder, which is also what pins the token version the e"},{"id":"p13s8","text":"ndpoint now expects. If read-aloud stops working again, test that token first: it is the only part o"},{"id":"p13s9","text":"f this plugin that can expire without the code changing."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- A DeepSeek Harness surface — `dsh web`, or the desktop app — version `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer.
- Netw"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ork access to the speech service. Nothing else: there is no model to download, and the Edge provider"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"speech service. collapses the two."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Desktop app** — sidebar → **Plugins** → **Add plugin**, then give one of:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `@nakamuraia/dsh-plugin-speech` (the npm registry)

[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Synthesis lives on the host because a browser cannot hold an API key and cannot reach most services "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"across CORS. The browser only posts text and plays bytes. Every editable leaf of the entry config is"},{"id":"p34s3","text":" `.volatile()`, so a settings write lands in the running host without reloading it — the host reads "},{"id":"p34s4","text":"the same value the browser wrote."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"One request is the point. Every extra request pays a fresh handshake — around 0.9 s to the service —"},{"id":"p35s2","text":" and adds a connection that can be dropped; sending the whole reply once means one handshake and one"},{"id":"p35s3","text":" stream. The service is fast enough for that to be the right trade: measured at **73x realtime** on "},{"id":"p35s4","text":"a warm connection and 1.5x on a cold one, so a two-minute reading arrives in under two seconds while"},{"id":"p35s5","text":" the first second of it is already playing."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The 1.5-second head is the whole latency budget. It exists to cover the jitter between the first chu"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"nk and the next one, not to wait for a useful part of the reply: a smaller head starts playing on th"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"e first frame and occasionally stutters, a larger one buys nothing. If the stream dies after the voi"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"ce started, what is already buffered still plays out; if the engine refuses the buffer outright the "},{"id":"p36s5","text":"reply is played as one whole file instead."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"A voice can also end every sentence with a long silence of its own — `pt-BR-AntonioNeural`, the sche"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"ma default, leaves about 0.9 s at each one, while the multilingual voices leave none. That silence i"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"s in the audio the service returns, not in how this plugin plays it."}],"truncated":true}
